name: seele-recall
description: Search the user's seele-memory encrypted corpus and decrypt snippets locally before returning them as RAG context. Privacy: only embedding vectors + ciphertext leave the bot's host.

query.description: Plaintext question. Sent to @seele/memory-client to embed; the *plaintext* never leaves the bot host.

top_k.description: How many snippets to retrieve (1-50). Default 5.

snippets.description: Decrypted plaintext snippets, ready to use as conversation context.

query_id.description: Server-side correlation id for this recall call.

notes: This action runs in the user's Python/JavaScript runtime that proxies Claude's tool call.
The bot grant JWT (SEELE_BOT_JWT) is minted out-of-band via `POST /api/bots` and expires in 15min; refresh when near expiry.
SEELE_AES_KEY_B64 is the user's AES-256 content key in base64. Derived once from their 12-word recovery phrase; do not log it.
Replace the placeholder values with your own. Do NOT commit real tokens.
